question: On what causal ground is the bali offering declared to be so named?
premises: A cause is given in the fused compound form.
Bali is the item under designation.
inference: By reason of pacifying clinging sin, the offering called bali is so designated.
uncertainties: Precise internal scope of the fused compound remains only as given
plain_english: By pacifying clinging sin, the offering is called bali.
